gloss: cooking method; way of preparing food

definitions.gloss: cooking method; recipe; way of preparing food
definitions.explanation: A method or technique used to prepare food, such as grilling, steaming, frying, or boiling. Also used more broadly for recipes or preparation instructions.

examples.japanese: {調理法|ちょうりほう}によって{味|あじ}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The flavor changes depending on the cooking method.

examples.japanese: この{野菜|やさい}にはどんな{調理法|ちょうりほう}が{合|あ}いますか。
examples.english: What cooking methods suit this vegetable?

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{食材|しょくざい}でも{調理法|ちょうりほう}を{変|か}えれば、まったく{違|ちが}う{料理|りょうり}になる。
examples.english: Even with the same ingredients, if you change the cooking method, it becomes a completely different dish.

notes:
A compound of {調理|ちょうり} (cooking, food preparation) and {法|ほう} (method, way). Refers to specific techniques like {焼|や}く (grilling), {蒸|む}す (steaming), {煮|に}る (simmering), and {揚|あ}げる (deep-frying).

COMMON JAPANESE COOKING METHODS:
- {焼|や}く — to grill, roast, bake
- {煮|に}る — to simmer, stew
- {蒸|む}す — to steam
- {揚|あ}げる — to deep-fry
- {炒|いた}める — to stir-fry
- {茹|ゆ}でる — to boil

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理法|ちょうりほう}を{工夫|くふう}する — to be creative with cooking methods
- {調理法|ちょうりほう}を{変|か}える — to change the cooking method
- {基本的|きほんてき}な{調理法|ちょうりほう} — basic cooking methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レシピ — recipe (loanword, more common for specific instructions)
- {料理法|りょうりほう} — cooking method (synonym, slightly less common)
- {調理|ちょうり} — cooking, food preparation (the process itself)
